limitations: L4 denotes offline synthetic fixture acceptance with hand-derived numbers and exercised seeded refusals, never a labelled shelf life, product-quality, safety, regulatory or clinical claim.
One-sided mean-response bounds are pointwise and conditional on linear independent homoscedastic normal residuals; model adequacy and simultaneous coverage remain unverified.
OLS refuses correctly retained censored values, perfect lines and zero time variance instead of substituting values or returning misleading significance.
Hash declarations cannot independently establish historical freeze timing, real source identity or independence. Review and rigor remain coordinator-owned; this pack leaves review unavailable.

Conservative English case-insensitive whole-word prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Incomplete for unlisted paraphrases and includes negations. Additional refusals cover truth, shelf life (joined, spaced or hyphenated), expir*, product quality, product safety, physical validity and patient benefit*. Phrase separators accept spaces or hyphens.

Unavailable text additionally refuses supported, replicated, suggestive and significan*. Any unavailable kind/result citation requires unavailable status including mixed lists. Empty evidence requires unavailable; replicated is always refused for this single synthetic fixture.

Positive statuses cannot cite records whose kind or result contains review, approv, comput, numer, agreement, truth, physical or clinic. A source declared external, independent or preregistered cannot alias study artifacts by path or hash.
Raw artifacts are bounded to 64 MiB each and 256 MiB per bundle across distinct inodes; JSON values are bounded before parsing. Input files and every ancestor are rechecked before acceptance.
